headline: 'First move-in' at Gyeyang New Town… supply speeds up, including private sales
summary: Move-ins at Gyeyang New Town, a third-wave new town, will begin in December with 1,285 households in blocks A2 and A3. Private mixed-use sales of 1,110 units are set to launch in October.
why: New-town supply programmes shape South Korea's housing market and property developers' pipelines. Housing supply affects prices and construction activity.
